title: What Remains Alive
description: A child dances before the fallen figure of Ramesses II. Against the scale and stillness of the monument, a fleeting gesture suggests a different kind of continuity: one carried through play, movement, and lived experience.

images.alt: A child moves between tall sandstone columns in front of a fallen monumental statue.

title: The City Ripples, So Do We
description: Reflected in a puddle, Canton Tower loses its fixed outline. Ripples carry the skyline and passing pedestrians into the same shifting surface. The photograph considers architecture through participation and change, where the apparent permanence of buildings meets the passing lives around them.

images.alt: A tower and passing pedestrians reflected in rippling water.

title: Playful Growth
description: A mother and son play soccer beneath two towers under construction. In the warm evening light, the small exchange on the field sits alongside a city taking shape. Play, care, and growth unfold at very different scales.

images.alt: A child kicks a soccer ball toward a woman in red beneath two towers under construction.

title: Dancing with Gravity
description: A raised pair of arms and a reflected figure appear suspended against a pale, gridded surface. Below them, a dense field of marks bends into a sharp corner, bringing gesture, reflection, and architectural geometry into the same frame.

images.alt: A person with raised arms is reflected above a sharply folded, patterned surface.

title: The Firework’s Echo
description: Smoke and sparks gather above a seated figure in red. A green chair and the edge of a wooden table emerge from the surrounding darkness. The scene is briefly filled with light.

images.alt: A seated figure in red is partly hidden by a glowing cloud of smoke and sparks.

title: Monochrome Richness, Sensorial Romance
description:
Tender thoughts, A mono serenade.
Freedom blooms, Unfettered grace.

title: High-Low Freedom
description: Seen from a balcony, a pool, rooftops, and streets gather into a steep, sunlit view of Davie Village. The photograph holds the neighbourhood’s vibrant public life against the shadowed railing, reflecting on freedom, belonging, and the boundaries that can remain around them.

images.alt: A steep view down past shoes and a balcony railing toward a pool, rooftops, and streets.
Two people share an umbrella as they cross a rain-soaked city street.
A small figure appears between angular planes of pale timber slats.

title: A Light Kept for Return
description: A cat pauses in the reflected lamplight of a narrow passage in the medina of Fes. Cloth awnings, hanging garments, and rain-darkened stones give the street the intimacy of a room. Everyday traces of care keep this worn space inhabited.

images.alt: A cat in a narrow night-time passage lit by amber lamps reflected on wet stones.
Silhouettes of people seen through translucent glass stair treads, in black and white.

title: The Architecture of a Spark
description: On New Year’s Eve, light passes between people gathered before Delft’s Stadhuis. Sparks briefly illuminate faces and gestures while the historic façade recedes into darkness. The photograph observes a city through the temporary rituals and shared encounters that give it life.

images.alt: People exchange sparkler light on a dark street, briefly illuminating faces and hands.
